checks.what: seleucid-empire_-291 adjust: Cliopatria outline plus Sogdia and Bactria minus the Maurya -291 Badakhshan strip. Page (opened in this review): 'Towards the end of Antiochus II's reign, various provinces simultaneously asserted their independence' ... 'such as Bactria and Sogdiana under Diodotus'; 'Diodotus, the Seleucid governor for the Bactrian territory, asserted independence in around 245 BC'; the cession to Chandragupta is 'territory west of the Indus, including the Hindu Kush', Gedrosia and Arachosia, not Bactria or Sogdiana. So Sogdia and Bactria stay Seleucid until the secession; the shapes end at 257 and the Greco-Bactrian dossier founds in Bactria at 256, inside the page's window. Spec: Cliopatria's own outline plus (Sogdia+Bactria = 1,651 cells, 417,500 km2) minus Cliopatria Maurya -291 (67 cells, the Badakhshan strip) = 1,584 cells, of which 788 are new beyond the outline (the 797-cell strip of the published 291 snap); the added land is disjoint from the Maurya dossier's own corrected 291 shape (0 cells in common). Same regions as the m0400-m0301 keyframe_overrides/13 the seam item asked to continue; the gazetteer's Sogdia and Bactria take in the Kyzylkum of Navoi and the Gorno-Badakhshan Pamirs, wider than the page's names, but narrowing them here alone would put a strip back at 291. Trial (m0300-m0201, all patches): the 291 snap goes from 19 added / 797 removed to 20 added / 10 removed; render of -260 shows the Seleucid realm holding Sogdia and Bactria against Maurya's Hindu Kush. The Sogdian fringe (558 cells: Navoi 363, Bukhoro 81, Jizzakh 68) now goes to nobody at the 256 snap instead of at 291 (no regression; same cells were nobody's from 291 before). End anchor m0200: the only owner change against the published anchor is 1,129 Yayoi cells (an unrelated dossier edit), none in Central Asia.
checks.fix: correction.text and why said 'the 65 cells of the Badakhshan mountains'; the subtracted set (Sogdia+Bactria intersect Cliopatria Maurya -291) resolves to 67 cells (35.63-37.46 N, 70.71-74.98 E), so both texts now say 67. Spec unchanged.
